title: DOC: tweaks and fixes for string functionality docs
body:
### PR summary
Fixes a number of minor issues and inaccuracies in the docs. 

* Using `r""` strings in the docstrings for `encode` and `decode` is necessary because there are inline control characters.
* Refer to null-padded strings instead of zero-padded or null-terminated strings
* Correct docs that predate StringDType short string support
* Don't talk about raw bytes as an encoding.

#### AI Disclosure
An AI helped me spot these problems as part of work on bytestringdtype.
